headline: Pakistan's First Hazara Female Lawyer Wins Right Livelihood Award
meta_description: Jalila Haider, the first female lawyer from Pakistan's Hazara community, has won the 2026 Right Livelihood Award for her work defending vulnerable people.
summary_short: Jalila Haider, Pakistan's first female Hazara lawyer, wins prestigious Right Livelihood Award for defending vulnerable people through her firm's 7,000+ cases.
body:
Jalila Haider, the first female lawyer from Pakistan's Hazara community, has won the 2026 Right Livelihood Award for her work defending vulnerable people.

Haider's legal firm has handled more than 7,000 cases, providing crucial representation to some of Pakistan's most marginalized communities. Her achievement marks a watershed moment for women from the Hazara ethnic group—a persecuted minority in Pakistan who have historically faced severe barriers to education and professional advancement.

The Right Livelihood Award recognizes individuals and organizations working on solutions to the root causes of poverty, violence, and environmental destruction. Haider's recognition underscores how legal advocacy can become a lifeline for those without resources or voice, transforming how vulnerable populations access justice in a complex system.
